title: EspressoLab model coefficients
description: Empirical coefficients, versioned separately from recipes and solver code (section 10.2). Every value is a calibration target, not a universal constant.
$comment: Audit P6, issue #19: schemas/ documents the intended contract; engine/artifact_io's C++ loaders are the executable one (CLAUDE.md 'Data contracts'). Where the two could differ, this file is kept synchronized to engine/artifact_io/json_io.cpp's load_coefficients_json() and engine/espresso_core/types.cpp's ModelCoefficients::validate() -- a mismatch found later is a schema bug, not a loader bug.

version.description: Semantic version of this coefficient set.

provenance.description: Where these numbers came from and what they may not be used for (section 11.3).

values.$comment: load_coefficients_json() reads every key below with required_number() -- an absent key is a MISSING_FIELD error, not a default. Every property must therefore be listed as required here too, matching the loader rather than leaving each individually optional the way an untouched 'properties'-only object implies.

minimum_porosity.description: Must also not exceed initial_porosity; that cross-field bound is enforced by ModelCoefficients::validate(), not expressible as a plain JSON Schema range here.

maximum_flow_m3_s.description: Numerical guard only; hitting it raises a hard warning (section 6.5).
